name: Hibernate (Rogue Genius Games)
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 6

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you

DESCRIPTION

As temporal stasis, but it ends when a condition (for example “when this torch is lit,” “when winter ends) defined by you (at casting) is met.
